svg.title: Front elevation, doors closed: tall cabinet at the left wall, six TV doors to the right wall
svg.text: tall door 82-11/16 x 18-1/8 (5/8 MDF, 5 hinges at the wall side)
kick, TV (5/8 MDF) -- set back 2-1/2 behind the door face, so it is not on this plane
TV top slab, 1/2 MDF, 19-7/16 to 19-15/16 (two pieces, joint over divider 3)
every TV door hinges on its LEFT edge and opens right;
cups 3-1/2 from the door top and bottom (guide 4)
tall door 18-1/8 (flush with the right face)
left edges of doors D1 to D6 from the left wall; pitch 30-7/64 = door 29-63/64 + 1/8 reveal
front elevation, doors closed -- this is what the room sees
